name: whatiuse-agent
title: whatiuse Agent Contract
description: Machine-readable recipe selection, composition, rejection, and quality contracts for coding agents.

files.content:
{
  "$schema": "https://whatiuse.minwookshin.com/agent/whatiuse-agent.schema.json",
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "version": "0.1.0-rc.43",
  "generatedBy": "scripts/build-agent-contract.mjs",
  "system": {
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "product": "whatiuse",
    "principles": [
      "stable geometry",
      "shared origin",
      "reversible completion"
    ],
    "workflow": [
      "inspect project",
      "classify task",
      "select recipe",
      "verify boundaries",
      "install source",
      "compose with public APIs",
      "run quality gates"
    ],
    "qualityGates": [
      "TypeScript",
      "production build",
      "keyboard path",
      "accessible names and semantics",
      "light and dark themes",
      "reduced motion",
      "no undocumented API",
      "no forbidden-rule violation"
    ]
  },
  "components": [
    {
      "id": "button",
      "title": "Button",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Compact action hierarchy with loading-state geometry.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/button",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "class-variance-authority@^0.7.1"
      ],
      "useWhen": "The user needs to start or confirm a discrete action.",
      "avoidWhen": "Navigation is the intent. Use a link that can still look like a button.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Hover",
        "Pressed",
        "Focus",
        "Loading",
        "Disabled",
        "Long label"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab to focus",
        "Enter or Space to activate",
        "Focus remains while loading"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Stable loading geometry",
        "One primary action per surface",
        "Label never wraps"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "icon-button",
      "title": "Icon Button",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Accessible square icon action with tooltip support.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/icon-button",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/button",
        "@whatiuse/tooltip"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [],
      "useWhen": "A familiar icon can represent a frequent action in a constrained area.",
      "avoidWhen": "The icon is ambiguous without explanation. Prefer a labelled Button.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Hover",
        "Pressed",
        "Focus",
        "Loading",
        "Disabled",
        "Tooltip"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab to focus",
        "Enter or Space to activate",
        "Tooltip appears on focus"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Accessible name required",
        "Tooltip recommended",
        "Consistent 15px glyph box"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "field",
      "title": "Field & Fieldset",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Accessible labels, guidance, validation, and grouped form semantics.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/field",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A control needs a persistent label, supporting guidance, validation, or grouping semantics.",
      "avoidWhen": "The content is not form input or the label would only repeat nearby visible context.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "With description",
        "Focus",
        "Error",
        "Required",
        "Read only",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Label activates the associated control",
        "Tab follows native form order",
        "Error and description remain referenced"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "One semantic field boundary",
        "Guidance stays stable during validation",
        "Fieldset uses a visible legend"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "input-group",
      "title": "Input Group",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "One text-entry boundary with contextual addons and compact actions.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/input-group",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base",
        "@whatiuse/button"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [],
      "useWhen": "An addon or action belongs inside the same visual entry boundary as one text input.",
      "avoidWhen": "The adjacent controls perform unrelated work or several inputs form a compound value.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Leading addon",
        "Trailing action",
        "Keyboard hint",
        "Focus",
        "Error",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab reaches the input first",
        "Trailing actions remain separately tabbable",
        "Native text editing is unchanged"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Exactly one text input",
        "One shared focus boundary",
        "Disabled and invalid state propagate to interactive children"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "kbd",
      "title": "Kbd",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Presentational keyboard hints for keys, chords, and sequences.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/kbd",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [],
      "useWhen": "A visible hint explains a real keyboard shortcut or key sequence.",
      "avoidWhen": "The key is interactive on its own or no working shortcut exists.",
      "states": [
        "Single key",
        "Modifier chord",
        "Sequence",
        "Inside button",
        "Inside input"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Never enters the tab order",
        "Reading order matches activation order",
        "Shortcut behavior is documented elsewhere"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Presentational only",
        "Compact but readable",
        "Platform notation remains consistent"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "button-group",
      "title": "Button Group",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Related actions with shared rhythm and optional joined geometry.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/button-group",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [],
      "useWhen": "Two or more related actions benefit from shared alignment or joined geometry.",
      "avoidWhen": "Actions are unrelated, one action dominates an entire form, or arrow-key navigation is expected.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Attached",
        "Mixed hierarchy",
        "With icon",
        "Vertical",
        "Disabled item"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Group has an accessible name",
        "Each button keeps ordinary Tab behavior",
        "No implicit arrow-key navigation"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Related actions only",
        "Joined edges do not double",
        "Hierarchy remains visible without extra borders"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "toolbar",
      "title": "Toolbar",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Compact frequently used controls with roving keyboard navigation.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/toolbar",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A compact set of frequent peer controls benefits from one arrow-navigable region.",
      "avoidWhen": "Actions are infrequent, form submission is the main task, or controls need explanatory copy.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Disabled item",
        "With popup",
        "Vertical"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab enters once",
        "Arrow keys move between controls",
        "Home and End reach edges",
        "Popup triggers preserve toolbar navigation"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Groups and toolbar are named",
        "One optional input appears last",
        "Icons keep specific accessible names"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "text-field",
      "title": "Text Field",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Dense labelled input with hints, validation, and adornments.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/text-field",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [],
      "useWhen": "The user enters a short, unstructured value.",
      "avoidWhen": "A finite option set can be selected with less effort.",
      "states": [
        "Empty",
        "Filled",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Error",
        "Read only",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab to focus",
        "Native text editing",
        "Error is referenced by the input"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Persistent label",
        "Inline validation",
        "No placeholder as label"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "number-field",
      "title": "Number Field",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Locale-aware bounded numeric input with direct entry and step controls.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/number-field",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "The value is numeric and stepping, bounds, or locale-aware formatting reduce entry errors.",
      "avoidWhen": "The number is an identifier, phone number, postal code, or another string that is not mathematically stepped.",
      "states": [
        "Empty",
        "Value",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Stepped",
        "Bounds",
        "Error",
        "Read only",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Arrow Up and Down step",
        "Shift uses the large step",
        "Home and End reach bounds when supported"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Native text entry remains available",
        "Buttons keep a specific accessible name",
        "Formatting never hides the raw submitted value"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "segmented-control",
      "title": "Segmented Control",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Compact single selection between visible peer views or presentation modes.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/segmented-control",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Two to four short peer options should remain visible and switch immediately.",
      "avoidWhen": "Options are numerous, require descriptions, or submit later as part of a form.",
      "states": [
        "Default",
        "Selected",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Keyboard moved",
        "Disabled item",
        "Disabled group",
        "Long label"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab enters the group",
        "Arrow keys move focus",
        "Space toggles the focused item"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "One selection stays visible",
        "Labels remain short",
        "Selected state is not color-only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "date-picker",
      "title": "Calendar & Date Picker",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Locale-aware date entry and calendar selection with shared validation.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/date-picker",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@internationalized/date@^3.12.3",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10",
        "react-aria-components@^1.20.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A date must be entered precisely while a calendar also makes nearby dates easier to inspect.",
      "avoidWhen": "The value is relative prose, a date range, or a full scheduling workflow with time zones and recurrence.",
      "states": [
        "Empty",
        "Value",
        "Focus",
        "Open",
        "Selected date",
        "Unavailable date",
        "Error",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Arrow keys edit segments or move dates",
        "Page Up and Down move months",
        "Enter selects",
        "Escape closes and restores focus"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Locale and calendar system are inherited",
        "Typed and picked values stay synchronized",
        "Unavailable dates remain legible and announced"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "checkbox",
      "title": "Checkbox",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/checkbox",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Several independent options may be selected together.",
      "avoidWhen": "A setting takes effect immediately. Use Switch for that case.",
      "states": [
        "Unchecked",
        "Checked",
        "Indeterminate",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Required",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab to focus",
        "Space to toggle",
        "Label activates the control"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "16px visual target",
        "40px effective target",
        "Mixed state is explicit"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "switch",
      "title": "Switch",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/switch",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Changing the setting should take effect immediately.",
      "avoidWhen": "The change must be reviewed and submitted with a form.",
      "states": [
        "Off",
        "On",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Disabled",
        "With description"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab to focus",
        "Space to toggle",
        "State is announced as checked"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Immediate feedback",
        "Visible label",
        "On state is not color-only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tooltip",
      "title": "Tooltip",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/tooltip",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A concise label clarifies an otherwise understandable control.",
      "avoidWhen": "The content is required to complete the task or contains actions.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Delayed open",
        "Pointer open",
        "Keyboard open",
        "Collision"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Focus opens",
        "Escape closes",
        "Focus remains on the trigger"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "One short sentence",
        "No interactive content",
        "Placement can adapt"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "popover",
      "title": "Popover",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/popover",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A small set of controls belongs next to its trigger.",
      "avoidWhen": "The task requires full attention, long forms, or a destructive decision.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Open",
        "Focus within",
        "Collision",
        "Outside press",
        "Escape dismissed",
        "Focus restored"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Enter or Space opens",
        "Tab moves within",
        "Escape closes and restores focus"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Anchored to origin",
        "Non-modal by default",
        "Clear local action hierarchy"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "menu",
      "title": "Menu",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/menu",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Related actions need a compact, temporary container.",
      "avoidWhen": "Options must remain visible for comparison or frequent access.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Open",
        "Highlighted",
        "Checked",
        "Disabled",
        "Destructive",
        "Typeahead"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Arrow keys move",
        "Home and End jump",
        "Typeahead searches",
        "Escape closes"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Logical grouping",
        "Short action labels",
        "Destructive action is separated"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "dialog",
      "title": "Dialog",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/dialog",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/icon-button"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A short, reversible task needs focused attention and a clear completion point.",
      "avoidWhen": "The work can be completed inline, requires a long workflow, or demands an explicit consequential response. Use Alert Dialog for the latter.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Entering",
        "Open",
        "Focus trapped",
        "Submitting",
        "Error",
        "Escape dismissed",
        "Exiting"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Focus enters",
        "Tab is contained",
        "Escape closes",
        "Focus returns to origin"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Clear task title and description",
        "First meaningful control is reachable",
        "Cancel and completion are explicit"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "context-menu",
      "title": "Context Menu",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Object-specific actions opened by right click, long press, or keyboard.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/context-menu",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A familiar object has secondary actions that benefit from right click or long press and also have a keyboard path.",
      "avoidWhen": "The action is required, frequent, undiscoverable without instruction, or the trigger has no stable object boundary.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Pointer open",
        "Keyboard open",
        "Highlighted",
        "Checked",
        "Disabled",
        "Destructive"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Shift + F10 or Context Menu key opens",
        "Arrow keys move",
        "Enter activates",
        "Escape closes and restores focus"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Core actions remain discoverable elsewhere",
        "Trigger has a visible object boundary",
        "Long press never blocks ordinary scrolling"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "sheet",
      "title": "Sheet",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Edge-aligned focused panel with modal focus and spatial context.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/sheet",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base",
        "@whatiuse/icon-button"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0",
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A focused task needs more room than a Popover but the originating page should remain spatially legible.",
      "avoidWhen": "The task is a short anchored choice, a full destination, or a gesture-driven drawer with snap points.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Entering",
        "Open",
        "Focus trapped",
        "Long content",
        "Escape dismissed",
        "Exiting"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Focus enters the panel",
        "Tab stays contained",
        "Escape closes",
        "Focus returns to the trigger"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Edge origin stays clear",
        "Title and description are present",
        "Footer actions remain visible without obscuring content"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "alert-dialog",
      "title": "Alert Dialog",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Explicit modal response for consequential or irreversible actions.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/alert-dialog",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A consequential action must interrupt the task and requires an explicit response.",
      "avoidWhen": "The action is safely reversible with Undo or ordinary information is being displayed.",
      "states": [
        "Closed",
        "Entering",
        "Open",
        "Focus trapped",
        "Confirming",
        "Error",
        "Exiting"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Focus enters the safe action",
        "Tab stays contained",
        "Escape requests close",
        "Focus returns to the trigger"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Consequence is concrete",
        "Safe and destructive labels are specific",
        "No ambiguous backdrop-only dismissal"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "tabs",
      "title": "Tabs",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/tabs",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@base-ui/react@^1.7.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Peer views of the same object can switch without navigation.",
      "avoidWhen": "The sections form a sequence or users need to compare them simultaneously.",
      "states": [
        "Inactive",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Active",
        "Disabled",
        "Long label"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Arrow keys move",
        "Home and End jump",
        "Automatic activation"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Short labels",
        "Stable panel height",
        "Active state is not color-only"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "toast",
      "title": "Toast",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/toast",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "sonner@^2.0.8"
      ],
      "useWhen": "The result is useful but should not block the current task.",
      "avoidWhen": "The user must act before continuing or the error belongs beside a field.",
      "states": [
        "Neutral",
        "Success",
        "Error",
        "Loading",
        "With action",
        "Queued",
        "Long message"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Announced politely",
        "Action is tabbable",
        "Escape does not steal page focus"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Specific outcome",
        "One optional action",
        "One foreground message",
        "Repeated events upsert by id",
        "Does not cover primary controls"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "inline-edit",
      "title": "Inline Edit",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "In-place editing with save, cancel, blur, announcement, and focus restoration.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/inline-edit",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "A visible value is changed frequently and its location should remain stable.",
      "avoidWhen": "Validation is complex or several fields must be edited together.",
      "states": [
        "Read",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Editing",
        "Dirty",
        "Saving",
        "Error",
        "Disabled"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Enter edits or saves",
        "Escape cancels",
        "Tab saves and continues"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Geometry stays stable",
        "Original value is recoverable",
        "Async failure remains editable"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "reorderable-list",
      "title": "Reorderable List",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Pointer, touch, keyboard, and screen-reader reordering with visible drop intent.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/reorderable-list",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10",
        "react-aria-components@^1.20.0"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Users need to change a meaningful order and the new position can be previewed and reversed.",
      "avoidWhen": "Order is calculated, changes are destructive, or move up and down controls would be clearer for a tiny list.",
      "states": [
        "Idle",
        "Hover",
        "Focus",
        "Dragging",
        "Drop before",
        "Drop after",
        "Keyboard dragging",
        "Disabled item"
      ],
      "keyboard": [
        "Tab reaches the drag handle",
        "Enter starts keyboard drag",
        "Tab cycles available drop targets",
        "Enter drops and Escape cancels"
      ],
      "quality": [
        "Pointer, touch, keyboard, and screen readers reach parity",
        "Drop position is visible and announced",
        "Order changes are controlled and reversible"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "action-list",
      "title": "Action List",
      "type": "registry:ui",
      "description": "Filterable keyboard-first action list with active-descendant focus.",
      "registryItem": "@whatiuse/action-list",
      "registryDependencies": [
        "@whatiuse/whatiuse-base"
      ],
      "packageDependencies": [
        "@phosphor-icons/react@^2.1.10"
      ],
      "useWhen": "Many actions must be searched and executed without leaving keyboard flow.",
